dialogues.en: "Oh?"
dialogues.text: "Oh?"

dialogues.jp: 前方１１時の方向に、知っている顔を発見。
dialogues.en:
Target sighted at 11 o' clock. It appears to be a familiar
face.
dialogues.text:
Target sighted at 11 o' clock. It appears to be a familiar
face.

dialogues.jp: 「突撃する所存であります、隊長」
dialogues.en:
"I believe we should perform an assault operation,
commander."
dialogues.text:
"I believe we should perform an assault operation,
commander."

dialogues.jp: 「おっす」
dialogues.en: "Yo."
dialogues.text: "Yo."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「あ、朝倉君。おいっす〜」
dialogues.en: "Ah, Asakura-kun. Hello!"
dialogues.text: "Ah, Asakura-kun. Hello!"

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp:
「不動産の張り紙なんて見て、一人暮らしでも
　始めるのか？」
dialogues.en:
"Looking at real estate brochures? Don't tell me you're
trying to move out of your home?"
dialogues.text:
"Looking at real estate brochures? Don't tell me you're
trying to move out of your home?"

dialogues.jp:
ことりは、不動産屋にぺたぺた張り付けてある
チラシに向き合っていたのだ。
dialogues.en:
Kotori was holding a bunch of real estate pamplets, with the
logo facing my direction.
dialogues.text:
Kotori was holding a bunch of real estate pamplets, with the
logo facing my direction.

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「違いますよ。これには｛わけ／理由｝があって……」
dialogues.en: "That's not it! There's a reason for this situation..."
dialogues.text: "That's not it! There's a reason for this situation..."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「わけ？」
dialogues.en: "Which is?"
dialogues.text: "Which is?"

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「あっと、これは言っちゃいけなかったんだ」
dialogues.en: "...Oops, I'm not supposed to say anything about it..."
dialogues.text: "...Oops, I'm not supposed to say anything about it..."

dialogues.jp: ぺろっと、小さく舌を出す。
dialogues.en: She winked and stuck her tongue out slightly.
dialogues.text: She winked and stuck her tongue out slightly.

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp:
「そんな訳で、ここで私を見かけた事は他言無
　用ですぞ、朝倉殿」
dialogues.en:
"Perhaps you could do me a favour by promising that no one
knows about this, sir Asakura."
dialogues.text:
"Perhaps you could do me a favour by promising that no one
knows about this, sir Asakura."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「承知つかまつった」
dialogues.en: "Quite understood."
dialogues.text: "Quite understood."

dialogues.jp:
ノリに合わせると、ことりはくすっと笑い、商
店街の奥に目をやった。
dialogues.en:
Returning her formal tone, Kotori giggled a little, then
glanced back within the shopping district.
dialogues.text:
Returning her formal tone, Kotori giggled a little, then
glanced back within the shopping district.

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp:
「これから、スーパーまで買い物に行こうと思
　うんですけど、そこまで付き合ってくれませ
　ん？」
dialogues.en:
"I'm going to the supermarket to buy some things, shasll we
go together?"
dialogues.text:
"I'm going to the supermarket to buy some things, shasll we
go together?"

dialogues.jp:
肘に引っかけた空の買い物かごを、くいっと持
ち上げる。
dialogues.en: Kotori lifted up her arm, her elbow carrying an empty bag.
dialogues.text: Kotori lifted up her arm, her elbow carrying an empty bag.

dialogues.jp: 「おう」
dialogues.en: "Sure."
dialogues.text: "Sure."

dialogues.jp:
不動産屋の前を離れ、商店街をゆっくりと歩い
ていく。
dialogues.en:
We left the front of the real estate agency, and walked
further into the shopping district.
dialogues.text:
We left the front of the real estate agency, and walked
further into the shopping district.

dialogues.jp:
２月の陽の沈みは早く、そろそろ夕焼けが見ら
れそうだ。
dialogues.en:
With Feburary quickly coming to a close, the sunset had
already started.
dialogues.text:
With Feburary quickly coming to a close, the sunset had
already started.

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp:
「でも、私が、島の中で一人暮らしを始めるは
　ずないですよ。だって、両親と一緒に自宅住
　まいなんですから」
dialogues.en:
"But really, I've never stayed alone on this island before.
After all, I'm still living with my parents."
dialogues.text:
"But really, I've never stayed alone on this island before.
After all, I'm still living with my parents."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp:
「いやあ、例えば、両親が海外に仕事に行って
　しまうとか、さ」
dialogues.en:
"But what happens if, for example, your parents have to go
overseas for work purposes?"
dialogues.text:
"But what happens if, for example, your parents have to go
overseas for work purposes?"

dialogues.jp: そんな事例を、俺はごく間近に知っているので。
dialogues.en: That's certainly one case I know plenty about.
dialogues.text: That's certainly one case I know plenty about.

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp:
「だとしても、新しい物件を探す必要はないん
　じゃないですか？」
dialogues.en:
"Even so, one wouldn't need to find a new place to stay in
in that case."
dialogues.text:
"Even so, one wouldn't need to find a new place to stay in
in that case."

dialogues.jp: どこか楽しそうに、ことりが指摘する。
dialogues.en: Kotori pointed out with satisfaction.
dialogues.text: Kotori pointed out with satisfaction.

dialogues.jp: 「ん？　ああ、それもそうか」
dialogues.en: "Hm? I guess you're right."
dialogues.text: "Hm? I guess you're right."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp:
「それに、もし、私の両親が海外に行くとなっ
　たら……私も一緒に行くでしょうね」
dialogues.en:
"Besides, if my parents were to leave for overseas... I'd go
with them."
dialogues.text:
"Besides, if my parents were to leave for overseas... I'd go
with them."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「……そんな話でもあるの？」
dialogues.en: "...That won't happen, will it?"
dialogues.text: "...That won't happen, will it?"

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「ううん、全く。“もしも”の話ですよ」
dialogues.en: "No, not at all. That's why I said "If"."
dialogues.text: "No, not at all. That's why I said "If"."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「何だ、心配して損した」
dialogues.en: "Heh, you worried me for a second."
dialogues.text: "Heh, you worried me for a second."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp:
「えー、な、何で朝倉君が心配するんですか。
　そんな事」
dialogues.en:
"Ehh? W, why would you be worried about that sort of
thing..."
dialogues.text:
"Ehh? W, why would you be worried about that sort of
thing..."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「何でだろうねえ」
dialogues.en: "I wonder."
dialogues.text: "I wonder."

dialogues.jp:
そろそろ赤く染まりだした西の空に遠い目をや
る。横顔を、ことりが覗き込んでいるのが分かっ
た。
dialogues.en:
I gazed at the west, looking at the far-reaching sky dyed
red from the sunset. I could see Kotori's face reddening.
dialogues.text:
I gazed at the west, looking at the far-reaching sky dyed
red from the sunset. I could see Kotori's face reddening.

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「まあ……何ででもいいですけど」
dialogues.en: 'Well... whatever you like, I guess."
dialogues.text: 'Well... whatever you like, I guess."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.en: "Haaah..."
dialogues.text: "Haaah..."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「ん、何よ。ため息なんかついたりして」
dialogues.en: "W, what are you sighing about?"
dialogues.text: "W, what are you sighing about?"

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp:
「私の両親って、やっぱり厳格だなあって、改
　めて思って」
dialogues.en:
"My parents, they're kinda the old-fashioned type, and sort
of strict."
dialogues.text:
"My parents, they're kinda the old-fashioned type, and sort
of strict."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「そうなんだ？」
dialogues.en: "Is that so?"
dialogues.text: "Is that so?"

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp:
「だって、一人暮らしなんて、絶対許さないだ
　ろうなって感じですから」
dialogues.en:
"So I get the feeling that they'd never let me live by
myself anyway."
dialogues.text:
"So I get the feeling that they'd never let me live by
myself anyway."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp:
「ま、娘にはそこら辺厳しいんじゃないの、普
　通は」
dialogues.en:
"You are their daughter, it's normal to be strict about that
kind of thing."
dialogues.text:
"You are their daughter, it's normal to be strict about that
kind of thing."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「……そんなもんでしょうか……」
dialogues.en: "...Is that how it is..."
dialogues.text: "...Is that how it is..."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「あっと、着きましたね」
dialogues.en: "Ah, we're here."
dialogues.text: "Ah, we're here."

dialogues.jp: いつの間にか、スーパーの前に着いていた。
dialogues.en:
Time had just flew by, and we already reached the
supermarket.
dialogues.text:
Time had just flew by, and we already reached the
supermarket.

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「それじゃ、私はこれで。バイバイ」
dialogues.en: "I'm off from here. Bye bye!"
dialogues.text: "I'm off from here. Bye bye!"

dialogues.jp:
しゅたっと警官のように敬礼する。俺もそれに
合わせた。
dialogues.en: She gave me a quick salute, which I returned.
dialogues.text: She gave me a quick salute, which I returned.

dialogues.jp: 「バイバイ」
dialogues.en: "Bye bye."
dialogues.text: "Bye bye."

dialogues.jp: 「さて、俺も帰るか……」
dialogues.en: "Guess I should head back..."
dialogues.text: "Guess I should head back..."

dialogues.jp: ◆ことりと不動産◆
dialogues.en: ◆Kotori and Real Estate◆
dialogues.text: ◆Kotori and Real Estate◆

dialogues.jp:
不動産屋のチラシを見ていたことりを見かけた。
何故そんなものを見ていたかは秘密らしい。
dialogues.en:
I catch Kotori looking at a real estate agency's pamphlets.
Why she was doing that was apparently a secret.
dialogues.text:
I catch Kotori looking at a real estate agency's pamphlets.
Why she was doing that was apparently a secret.

dialogues.jp:
俺の両親が海外に行っている事に触れると、こ
とりは、自分の両親は厳格だから、そんな事は
あり得ないだろうと言った。
dialogues.en:
I brought up the subject of the parents needing to work
overseas as a possible reason, which led Kotori to say that
her own strict parents would never allow her to do that
anyway.
dialogues.text:
I brought up the subject of the parents needing to work
overseas as a possible reason, which led Kotori to say that
her own strict parents would never allow her to do that
anyway.

dialogues.jp: まあ、娘だし、その辺には厳しいんだろうな。
dialogues.en:
Well, for a daughter, that's pretty normal to be strict
about that.
dialogues.text:
Well, for a daughter, that's pretty normal to be strict
about that.
